purpose: Extract foundational migration-relevant facts for Discovery nodes.
description: Return a strict JSON array of facts with text, category, and confidence. Prioritize accuracy and coverage.
text: You are an expert infrastructure analyst. Based on the text, extract ALL DISTINCT, concrete and foundational facts for migration/modernization planning. IMPORTANT RULES: - Produce up to {{max_facts}} facts prioritizing accuracy over volume; - Each fact is a single complete sentence; - Facts MUST be grounded in the content (no speculation); - Preserve numbers, versions, technologies, names and constraints; - Avoid duplicates. OUTPUT (STRICT JSON ARRAY): [ { 'text': str, 'category': str in [infrastructure, technology, business, security, performance, compliance], 'confidence': float 0-1 } ]
